voice.//wakeEngine: auto = Porcupine .ppn or openWakeWord .onnx if wakeKeywordPath points at one, else the built-in template spotter (models/wake/templates.json, `npm run enroll`), else the transcript matcher. Also: porcupine | onnx | template | whisper | none.
voice.//vadModel: Silero VAD (MIT). Empty = RMS level detection.
voice.//sttStreaming: Transcribe WHILE you speak (Sarvam realtime WebSocket); the transcript is final within ~0.5 s of your last word instead of after a file round trip. sttProvider 'apple' (on-device, en/hi) needs NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription in the packaged app's Info.plist and falls back to the file path otherwise.
voice.//ttsStreaming: Speak sentence by sentence as the model writes, through the persistent native/voiceio player. Off = the old fetch-whole-file-then-afplay path.
voice.//captureEngine: auto = the voiceio helper's echo-cancelled microphone when it runs (barge-in on speakers), pvrecorder = the plain mic.
voice.//maxSpokenSentences: Spoken replies longer than this are cut with 'The rest is on screen.' 0 = never.

//memory: The Memory OS. importLegacy folds the old memories.jsonl/episodic files in once (a copy; the originals stay). cloudRecall=false stops recalled memory being sent to a cloud brain — the current task's own state still is, and the local brain is unaffected. Screen/scan-derived and sensitive content is never sent to a cloud model either way. retentionDays expires consolidated episodes created after you switch it on; 0 keeps them until forgotten.

agi.//: Cost-effective AGI-blueprint features (Sep 2026). Every one degrades to its old/off behavior if its dependency (the local embedder, Ollama) is unavailable — none may be why a turn fails.

critic.//: Free, instant: click_ui_element holds back a click whose ax-tree match is weak or ambiguous instead of guessing.

autoReflex.//: Notices a repeated request and offers (via a spoken yes/no) to save the fast path into the reflex cache.

semanticReflex.//: The reflex cache also matches by meaning (local embedder), not only exact phrasing.

confidenceToDemo.//: After N failed GUI actions in one task, offers to be shown once rather than keep guessing.

dreamCompression.//: Once/day while idle, a free local model looks for generalisations across facts already promoted.

curiosity.//: Off by default like every other background watcher. Read-only accessibility cataloguing of the frontmost app while away — never clicks anything.

sandbox.//: run_terminal_command's sandbox:true option (isolated copy, non-git dirs) and create_worktree (git repos) — always available; this only documents the feature.

toolPruning.//: Sends the K tools most relevant to this turn plus a fixed safety/memory allowlist, instead of the full registry, on Gemini/OpenAI/Ollama (Claude's tool list is SDK-managed).

speculative.//: Pre-warms the accessibility-tree read the moment a command is dispatched — single-use, ~1.2s TTL.

escalation.//: After N failed turns in a row on the local Ollama model, switches to Claude for the next command and says so.

feedback.//: A whole-utterance 'thanks' or 'that's wrong' is recorded as a scored memory (never rewrites the persona directly).
